import pathlib

pathlib.Path(p).write_text(r'''#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Control C1 - inherited grant-journal carrier laws, established by execution.
# Read-only against Source25. Writes only the report path given on argv[2].
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, re, sqlite3, sys

SRC = sys.argv[1]
OUT = sys.argv[2]
SEQ_MAX = 9007199254740991
R = {'control': 'c1-inherited-carrier-laws', 'sourceRoot': SRC}

def sha(path):
    b = open(path, 'rb').read()
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), len(b)

MEMBERS = [
    'docs/coop/completion/security-schemas.v2/grant-journal.sql',
    'docs/coop/completion/security-schemas.v2/journal-record.schema.json',
    'docs/coop/completion/security-schemas.v8/journal-record.schema.json',
    'docs/coop/completion/security_unit_lib_v8.py',
    'docs/coop/completion/security-completion.v1.md',
    'docs/coop/completion/security-completion.v8.md',
    'docs/coop/design-corrections/security/security-lifecycle.schemas.v1.json',
    'docs/v2/contracts/product-v1/security-and-lifecycle.md',
]
R['selectedSourceMembers'] = {}
for m in MEMBERS:
    h, n = sha(os.path.join(SRC, m))
    R['selectedSourceMembers'][m] = {'sha256': h, 'bytes': n}

# ---- 1. record_type set algebra from the actual frozen artifacts ----------------
ddl = open(os.path.join(SRC, MEMBERS[0]), encoding='utf-8').read()
phys_types = set(re.findall(r'[A-Z]+', re.search(r'record_type\s+TEXT\s+NOT NULL CHECK \(record_type IN\s*\(([^)]*)\)', ddl).group(1)))
b1 = json.load(open(os.path.join(SRC, MEMBERS[1]), encoding='utf-8'))
b1_types = set(v['properties']['recordType']['const'] for v in b1['oneOf'])
b1_schema = sorted(set(v['properties']['recordSchema']['const'] for v in b1['oneOf']))
sl = json.load(open(os.path.join(SRC, MEMBERS[6]), encoding='utf-8'))
b3_types = set(sl['defsAlias']['JournalRecord']['properties']['recordType']['enum']) if False else set(sl['$defs']['JournalRecord']['properties']['recordType']['enum'])
b2_types = set(sl['$defs']['JournalRecordV2']['properties']['recordType']['enum'])
lin_types = set(sl['schemas']['LinearizationV1']['properties']['journalTypes']['items']['enum'])
R['recordTypeAlgebra'] = {
    'physicalCheckDDL': sorted(phys_types),
    'logicalBodySchema1': sorted(b1_types),
    'logicalBodySchema1RecordSchemaConst': b1_schema,
    'logicalJournalRecordV2_schema2': sorted(b2_types),
    'logicalJournalRecord_schema3': sorted(b3_types),
    'linearizationV1JournalTypes': sorted(lin_types),
    'schema3_not_admitted_by_physical': sorted(b3_types - phys_types),
    'physical_not_in_schema3': sorted(phys_types - b3_types),
    'schema3_equals_linearizationTypes': sorted(b3_types) == sorted(lin_types),
    'schema1_equals_physical': sorted(b1_types) == sorted(phys_types),
}
R['recordTypeAlgebra']['schema3_closedBodies_additionalProperties'] = sl['$defs']['JournalRecord'].get('additionalProperties')

# ---- 2. platform vocabulary algebra -------------------------------------------
phys_platforms = set(re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_-]+', re.search(r'platform\s+TEXT CHECK \(platform IS NULL OR platform IN \(([^)]*)\)', ddl).group(1)))
sec = open(os.path.join(SRC, MEMBERS[7]), encoding='utf-8').read()
rows = re.findall(r'^\| .(macos|linux)[a-z0-9_-]*. \| ([a-z0-9_-]+) \|', sec, re.M)
machine = set(re.findall(r'^\| .([a-z0-9_-]+). \| ([a-z0-9_-]+) \|.*\|.*\|$', sec, re.M) and [] or [])
tbl = re.findall(r'^\| .([a-z0-9x_-]+). \| ([a-z0-9x_-]+) \| ', sec, re.M)
R['platformVocabulary'] = {
    'physicalCheckDDL': sorted(phys_platforms),
    's8Table_machineId_to_displayAlias': tbl,
    'machineIds': sorted(x[0] for x in tbl),
    'displayAliases': sorted(x[1] for x in tbl),
    'machineIds_not_admitted_by_physical': sorted(set(x[0] for x in tbl) - phys_platforms),
    'physical_values_that_are_display_aliases_only': sorted(phys_platforms & set(x[1] for x in tbl) - set(x[0] for x in tbl)),
    'lawfully_shared': sorted(phys_platforms & set(x[0] for x in tbl)),
}

# ---- 3. digest semantics from the frozen reference lib -------------------------
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sul8', os.path.join(SRC, MEMBERS[3]))
sul8 = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(sul8)
body = {'recordSchema': 1, 'grantGeneration': 1, 'seq': 1, 'operationRef': 'op-' + ('0' * 32),
        'wallClockData': '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 'recordType': 'REV', 'reason': 'operator'}
canon_text = sul8.canon(body)
canon_bytes = canon_text.encode('utf-8')
domain = sul8.DOMAIN_TAGS['journal']
R['digestSemantics'] = {
    'domainTag': domain,
    'canonicalBodyText': canon_text,
    'record_body_sha': sul8.record_body_sha(body),
    'raw_sha256_of_canonical_body': hashlib.sha256(canon_bytes).hexdigest(),
    'domain_framed_sha256': hashlib.sha256(domain.encode('utf-8') + b'\x00' + canon_bytes).hexdigest(),
}
R['digestSemantics']['body_sha256_equals_raw_sha256_of_body'] = (
    R['digestSemantics']['record_body_sha'] == R['digestSemantics']['raw_sha256_of_canonical_body'])
R['digestSemantics']['body_sha256_equals_domain_framed'] = (
    R['digestSemantics']['record_body_sha'] == R['digestSemantics']['domain_framed_sha256'])
R['digestSemantics']['journal_genesis_example'] = sul8.journal_genesis('proj-key-example', 1)
R['digestSemantics']['prev_sha256_formula_source'] = [
    l.strip() for l in open(os.path.join(SRC, MEMBERS[4]), encoding='utf-8').read().split(chr(10))
    if 'prev_sha256' in l and 'chain' in l]
src8 = open(os.path.join(SRC, MEMBERS[3]), encoding='utf-8').read()
R['digestSemantics']['reference_lib_defines_prev_sha_function'] = bool(
    re.search(r'def [a-z_]*prev[a-z_]*\(', src8))
R['digestSemantics']['journal_genesis_referenced_elsewhere_in_lib'] = len(
    re.findall(r'journal_genesis', src8)) - 1

# ---- 4. executed DDL law probes ------------------------------------------------
OPREF = 'op-' + ('a' * 32)
COLS = ('grantGeneration','seq','record_type','operation_ref','request_ref','token',
        'install_generation_id','manifest_digest','platform','body','body_sha256','prev_sha256')
H64 = 'b' * 64

def row(seq, rt, platform=None, token=None, igid=None, mdig=None, opref=OPREF):
    return (1, seq, rt, opref, None, token, igid, mdig, platform, '{}', H64, H64)

def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    c.executescript(ddl)
    return c

def ins(c, r):
    q = 'INSERT INTO grant_journal (' + ','.join(COLS) + ') VALUES (' + ','.join(['?'] * len(COLS)) + ')'
    try:
        c.execute(q, r)
        c.commit()
        return {'admitted': True, 'error': None}
    except sqlite3.Error as e:
        return {'admitted': False, 'error': str(e)}

probes = {}
GRANT_OK = dict(platform='macos-arm64', token='PT-FS-READ-PROJECT', igid='ig1', mdig='c' * 64)

c = fresh(); probes['L1_SEAL_append'] = ins(c, row(1, 'SEAL')); c.close()
c = fresh(); probes['L2_GRANT_machine_platform_id_macos_aarch64'] = ins(
    c, row(1, 'GRANT', platform='macos-aarch64', token='PT-FS-READ-PROJECT', igid='ig1', mdig='c' * 64)); c.close()
c = fresh(); probes['L2b_GRANT_machine_platform_id_linux_x86_64_gnu'] = ins(
    c, row(1, 'GRANT', platform='linux-x86_64-gnu', token='PT-FS-READ-PROJECT', igid='ig1', mdig='c' * 64)); c.close()
c = fresh(); probes['L3_GRANT_display_alias_macos_arm64'] = ins(c, row(1, 'GRANT', **GRANT_OK)); c.close()
c = fresh(); probes['L4_non_contiguous_seq_2_on_empty'] = ins(c, row(2, 'REV')); c.close()
c = fresh()
probes['L5a_first_REV'] = ins(c, row(1, 'REV'))
try:
    c.execute('UPDATE grant_journal SET body=?', ('{\"x\":1}',)); c.commit()
    probes['L5b_UPDATE'] = {'admitted': True, 'error': None}
except sqlite3.Error as e:
    probes['L5b_UPDATE'] = {'admitted': False, 'error': str(e)}
try:
    c.execute('DELETE FROM grant_journal'); c.commit()
    probes['L5c_DELETE'] = {'admitted': True, 'error': None}
except sqlite3.Error as e:
    probes['L5c_DELETE'] = {'admitted': False, 'error': str(e)}
c.close()
c = fresh()
probes['L6a_REV_seq1'] = ins(c, row(1, 'REV'))
probes['L6b_TERMINAL_seq2'] = ins(c, row(2, 'TERMINAL'))
probes['L6c_append_after_TERMINAL'] = ins(c, row(3, 'REV'))
c.close()
c = fresh(); probes['L7_seq_above_uint53_cap'] = ins(c, row(SEQ_MAX + 1, 'REV')); c.close()
c = fresh(); probes['L9_malformed_operation_ref'] = ins(c, row(1, 'REV', opref='op-XYZ')); c.close()

# reserved terminal slot: unreachable by contiguous append in bounded time.
# Harness: lift the contiguity trigger, seed tail = SEQ_MAX-1, reinstall the EXACT
# frozen trigger text read back from sqlite_master, then probe the reserved slot.
c = fresh()
trig = c.execute('SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=? AND name=?',
                 ('trigger', 'gj_seq_contiguous')).fetchone()[0]
c.execute('DROP TRIGGER gj_seq_contiguous'); c.commit()
seeded = ins(c, row(SEQ_MAX - 1, 'REV'))
c.executescript(trig)
probes['L8a_harness_seed_tail_SEQMAX_minus_1'] = seeded
probes['L8b_reserved_slot_non_TERMINAL'] = ins(c, row(SEQ_MAX, 'REV'))
probes['L8c_reserved_slot_TERMINAL'] = ins(c, row(SEQ_MAX, 'TERMINAL'))
c.close()
R['ddlProbes'] = probes
R['ddlProbeHarnessDisclosure'] = (
    'L8 only: the frozen gj_seq_contiguous trigger was dropped in an in-memory scratch copy to seed '
    'tail=SEQ_MAX-1, then reinstalled verbatim from sqlite_master before the reserved-slot probes. '
    'The reserved slot is otherwise unreachable in bounded time. No frozen file was modified.')
R['reinstalledTriggerTextEqualsFrozen'] = trig.strip() in ddl.strip()

# ---- 5. reconcile_witness table reproduction ----------------------------------
PK = 'proj-key-example'
GG = 1
pkd = sul8.project_key_digest(PK)
def w(seq, state, sha_=None):
    return {'witnessSchema': 1, 'projectKeyDigest': pkd, 'grantGeneration': GG,
            'seq': seq, 'state': state, 'bodySha256': sha_}
A, B = 'a' * 64, 'd' * 64
cases = [
    ('empty carrier, no witness', None, None),
    ('COMMITTED n = tail n, same body hash', (5, A), w(5, 'COMMITTED', A)),
    ('COMMITTED 0 on empty carrier', None, w(0, 'COMMITTED', None)),
    ('PENDING n+1 with tail n', (5, A), w(6, 'PENDING', B)),
    ('PENDING n = tail n, same hash', (5, A), w(5, 'PENDING', A)),
    ('COMMITTED n > tail', (5, A), w(7, 'COMMITTED', B)),
    ('COMMITTED n = tail n, different hash', (5, A), w(5, 'COMMITTED', B)),
    ('PENDING n = tail n, different hash', (5, A), w(5, 'PENDING', B)),
    ('tail > witness seq (COMMITTED)', (9, A), w(5, 'COMMITTED', B)),
    ('PENDING not adjacent to the tail', (5, A), w(9, 'PENDING', B)),
    ('witness absent with a non-empty journal', (5, A), None),
    ('witness fails the closed shape (PENDING 0)', (5, A), w(0, 'PENDING', None)),
    ('witness fails the closed shape (bool seq)', (5, A), w(True, 'COMMITTED', A)),
    ('witness names another carrier (generation)', (5, A),
     {'witnessSchema': 1, 'projectKeyDigest': pkd, 'grantGeneration': 2, 'seq': 5,
      'state': 'COMMITTED', 'bodySha256': A}),
]
R['reconcileWitness'] = []
for label, tail, wit in cases:
    act, det = sul8.reconcile_witness(tail, wit, PK, GG)
    R['reconcileWitness'].append({'case': label, 'tail': tail, 'action': act, 'detail': det})
R['reconcileWitnessConsultsHighWater'] = 'high' in importlib.util.find_spec and False
import inspect
R['reconcileWitnessSignature'] = str(inspect.signature(sul8.reconcile_witness))
R['reconcileWitnessSourceMentionsHighWater'] = 'highWater' in inspect.getsource(
    sul8._reconcile_witness_checked) or 'high_water' in inspect.getsource(sul8._reconcile_witness_checked)
R['witnessShapeRefusalProbe'] = sul8.witness_shape_refusals(w(5, 'PENDING', None))

open(OUT, 'w').write(json.dumps(R, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + chr(10))
print('WROTE', OUT)
for k in ('recordTypeAlgebra', 'platformVocabulary'):
    print(k, json.dumps(R[k], indent=1, sort_keys=True))
print('digestSemantics', json.dumps(R['digestSemantics'], indent=1, sort_keys=True))
''')
print('wrote control', p, len(open(p).read()), 'bytes')
"

open('scratch/t/cf3.md','w').write(r'''# Grant-journal physical carrier, carrierFormat 3 (PROPOSED design/reference correction)

**Standing.** Proposed versioned design and reference artifact resolving COV-03 and the
carrier findings CR-04 / CR-07. Authored by a non-blind actual Claude coauthor against frozen
Source25 (manifest `fa8cdc796c4dbab514c8b8a91a593b740e3f8e69d19574f4be11c6e00c3a536d`, all
12869 members verified this session). This grants no acceptance, no readiness, no application
and no implementation authorization. It is design/reference work: a physical DDL, an open/read
dispatch and reference validation. It is not product Rust, not executable storage and not a
crash-test result. No historical file is modified.
